WOODWORK — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: WOODWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Design in Woodwork, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Design in Woodwork.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Design in Woodwork.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Design in Woodwork.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Design in Woodwork.

2. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

3. When learning Entrepreneurship in Woodwork, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Entrepreneurship in Woodwork.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Entrepreneurship in Woodwork.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Entrepreneurship in Woodwork.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Entrepreneurship in Woodwork.

4. When learning Emergency Management, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Emergency Management.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Emergency Management.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Emergency Management.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Emergency Management.

5. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. Keyboard
   C. CPU
   D. Monitor

6. When learning Occupational Information, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Occupational Information.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Occupational Information.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Occupational Information.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Occupational Information.

7. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Run with the tool

8. When learning Upholstery, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Upholstery.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Upholstery.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Upholstery.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Upholstery.

9. When learning Fittings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Fittings.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fittings.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Fittings.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Fittings.

10. When learning Furniture Making, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Furniture Making.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Furniture Making.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Furniture Making.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Furniture Making.

11. When learning Blending wood with other materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Blending wood with other materials.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Blending wood with other materials.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Blending wood with other materials.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Blending wood with other materials.

12. When learning Project Activity, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Project Activity.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project Activity.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Project Activity.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project Activity.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Design in Woodwork and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Estimation of Materials and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Occupational Information and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Emergency Management and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
